dataset.sequence_unit: one complete run with 11 ordered valid snapshots

edge_attributes.directionality: each undirected physical edge is serialized as two directed COO entries with duplicated attributes

graph_handling.node_order: canonical G3 order: satellite numeric ascending, then ground_station_id lexical ascending
graph_handling.variable_node_counts: preserve exact per-snapshot node counts using snapshot_node_offsets and node_identity_index; no padding and no masking
graph_handling.failed_satellites: absent under accepted G3 operational graph semantics
graph_handling.failed_ground_stations: retained as nodes with operational_indicator=0 under the accepted persistent G5 overlay
graph_handling.zero_edge_snapshots: preserve exact edge_index shape [2,0] and edge_attr shape [0,10]; do not add self-loops, dummy edges, or fabricated edge weights
graph_handling.edge_attributes_in_contracted_model: edge_attr is preserved, validated, and serialized in the accepted schema. The contracted existing GCLSTM call consumes edge_index and no edge_attr-derived scalar edge_weight; no edge-aware redesign or scalar reduction is introduced in v1.
graph_handling.temporal_state: reset hidden and cell state at the beginning of every independent run; process snapshots in accepted temporal order; pool the final snapshot state

architecture.pooling: global mean pooling over final-timestep node embeddings
architecture.prediction_head: one Linear(hidden_dimension, 2) head for classification logits or one Linear(hidden_dimension, 1) head for regression scalar
architecture.activation: the contracted GCLSTM implementation and linear head; no additional activation or architectural block
architecture.architecture_change_policy: No attention, message-passing redesign, edge encoder, extra recurrent layer, or alternate pooling is permitted in v1.

optimization.batching: one complete temporal sequence per batch; batch size 1 is required by the contracted sequence-forward implementation
optimization.classification_loss: CrossEntropyLoss with weights computed from training labels only

candidate_search.strategy: exhaustive evaluation of the four predeclared Cartesian configurations; no adaptive search
candidate_search.candidate_order: hidden_dimension outer loop, learning_rate inner loop; all fixed singleton dimensions remain constant

checkpoint_selection.format: torch.save dictionary containing model_state_dict, optimizer_state_dict, epoch, selected configuration, target, preprocessing identity, seed, validation primary metric, and environment identity
checkpoint_selection.candidate_rule: retain the epoch with the best primary validation metric; use the full task selection hierarchy for equal primary values; if still tied, choose the earliest epoch
checkpoint_selection.final_repeated_seed_rule: each of five final seed runs uses the same frozen configuration and its validation-selected checkpoint; no test metric participates
checkpoint_selection.candidate_checkpoint_retention: candidate checkpoints are temporary execution artifacts and are not part of this planning commit

final_models.fit_data: training split only; validation remains a selection and early-stopping split; no train/validation merge
final_models.aggregation: classification soft probabilities and regression predictions are averaged across the five frozen seed runs before final test metrics
final_models.test_evaluation: one evaluation of the frozen five-seed ensemble after one-time authorization
